title: Abincin Dattijon da Ba Zato Ba
intro: A cikin tsarkakakken wurin Allah, wani bawan Allah dattijo ya fuskanci wani babban asiri wanda ya keta duk wani tsammani. Wannan mutum mai himma, tun bayan shekarun iyaye na halitta, ya shaida wani abu mai ban mamaki wanda ya bayyana rahamar Allah marar iyaka. Abin mamaki shine gano wannan lokacin da aka manta daga rayuwar annabawa.
clues: An san mutanena da Isra'ila, zuriyar wani babban uba na zamanin da.
Na kwana ina addu'a, ina sujada ga Ubangijina a cikin haikali.
An ba ni ɗa a lokacin da na tsufa, baiwar da ban taɓa daina ɗaukaka Allah a kanta ba.
Gwajina ya ƙunshi gano wani abin rayuwa da ya bayyana ga wani ƙaramin rai da ke ƙarƙashin kulawara.
Ni annabi ne mai suna Zakariyya, an ɗora min alhakin kula da Maryam a Baitul Maqdis.
Amsar tana cikin ayar da Allah ya karɓi Maryam ya kuma tanadar mata da abinci.

identity.label: Wanene Ni?
options: Annabin da ya kula da Maryamu a cikin haikali
Annabin da ya gina Haikalin Allah mai tsarki

Annabin da ya yi magana da Allah kai tsaye
identity.answer: Annabin da ya kula da Maryamu a cikin haikali

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
